column1: # Jiukong first-party heteronym tier overrides. See README.md.
# Each non-comment row is: character, tab, canonical Bopomofo reading, tab,
# usage tier (0 = common, 1 = semi-common, 2 = other/rare). The tier here
# wins over the pinned CNS plane tier for this exact (character, reading)
# pair only; every other reading of the same character is unaffected.
# 疋的主要讀音是 ㄆㄧˇ；它的 ㄕㄨ
# reading is an archaic/rare alternate that otherwise tied with 書, 舒, 俞,
# and other everyday ㄕㄨ characters and outranked them on CNS source order
# 食的 ㄧˋ 只用於人名「酈食其」；日常音是 ㄕˊ，作「給人吃／飼養」
# 時另讀 ㄙˋ。它不應只因「食」整字的 CNS 字面，就與日常 ㄧˋ 候選同層。
# 射的 ㄧˋ 限於古語及十二律名「無射」；日常音是 ㄕㄜˋ。它不應因
# 「射」整字的 CNS 字面，就與日常 ㄧˋ 候選同層。
